flags.message: Material advocacy/source distinction: the petition invokes Judge VanDyke's rehearing statement in support of review, but its own Appendix F at 61a and 67a–70a expressly agrees with the panel's mootness result and explains that a new abortion statute would not be restrained by the old injunction. Forecast follows the appended statement, not an inference that it dissented from the disposition. Appendix B also records Rule 60 burden/forfeiture issues. This is not a provisioning failure or outcome leakage; reasoning.md details the distinction.
